doc.name: Amino Desk
doc.instructions: Amino Desk is an independent, evidence-graded reference on peptides and GLP-1 medications for US readers: legal status, human evidence, reported dosing with sources, safety and cost. Use search to find a compound or topic, get_compound for one compound's full entry, list_compounds to filter by evidence grade, goal or legal status, and get_page for guides, comparisons and cost pages. Quote facts as written, keep the stated caveats, and cite the page URL. This is not medical advice.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Amino Desk
tools.description: Search Amino Desk's published pages on peptides and GLP-1 medications: compound entries, comparisons, guides, costs and legal status. Returns titles, URLs and snippets. Also finds brand names and seller code names mentioned on the site.
